_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Configuration Data Management Database-Open Architecture (CDMD-OA) CDMD-OA Metric Report
summary: This report identifies cost per transaction and efficiencies of the Configuration Data Manager (CDM) in processing CDMD-OA database transactions.
use_relationship:
This report will be used to identify cost per transaction and efficiencies of the Configuration Data Manager (CDM) in processing those transactions.
This Data item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by a specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall be presented in the Contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The SCLSIS Metric Report shall contain results of a Query of transaction data obtained from the CDMD-OA database reflecting the following:

children.title: Identity of the Configuration Data Manager (CDM)
Totals as well as source of transactions (ex., ship, ILO, DBR), processing rate and record type (RT2, 3, 4) breakouts.
Include general analysis and explanation of research performed identifying and explaining anomalous readings.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirement.
preparation_instructions.content: The media for this report shall be in Excel 97-2003.
